images.author: Matti Barthel
images.why: Exact Nyiragongo lava lake; original 4288 × 2848 photograph with glowing lava and dark volcanic surroundings.

images.author: Hanspeter Gass
images.why: Dramatic red lava lake framed by dark crater walls; landscape composition with a strong central focal point. Linked rendition is 2048 × 1365.

images.author: Hatem Boukhit
images.why: Explicitly identified as Elephant Rock, AlUla; recognisable sandstone formation in its desert setting. Canon EOS M50 photograph.

images.author: Arne Backhaus
images.why: Source specifically identifies Jabal AlFil in AlUla; clear elephant-shaped rock silhouette and surrounding desert. Canon EOS 2000D photograph.

images.author: ahmed moawad
images.why: 3024 × 4032 original with blue sky and warm sandstone tones; portrait framing offers an alternative for the near-square card.

images.author: David Heptinstall
images.why: Photographer explicitly confirms Divisadero viewpoint; expansive Copper Canyon landscape. Original 3072 × 2304 provides useful cropping room.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Broad Divisadero vista with green canyon slopes, rocky ridges and substantial depth; original asset URL, but native dimensions are unconfirmed.

images.author: Robin Noguier
images.why: Elevated Bromo sunrise landscape with layered mountains and cool dawn colour; photographer describes hiking to the opposite viewpoint. Sony ILCE-7M2 photograph.

images.author: Sébastien Lavalaye
images.why: Source confirms sunrise from King Kong Hill: Bromo volcanic complex, smoke rising from the crater and thick clouds filling the caldera.

images.author: Arya Krisdyantara
images.why: Bromo surrounded by morning clouds; atmospheric alternative emphasising the volcano and sea of mist.

images.author: Esaias Tan
images.why: Confirmed sunrise in Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park; smoking crater and golden-hour mountain scenery.

images.author: Jillian Amatt - Artistic Voyages
images.why: Explicitly geolocated to the Pyramids of Meroë; grouped steep pyramids in a desert setting. Documented iPhone 11 Pro photograph.

images.author: Erik Hathaway
images.why: Golden dunes and rows of Meroë pyramids in morning light, explicitly photographed without visitors. Stitched photographic panorama; a 9:10 crop would isolate one pyramid group.
